photo.credit: NASA · Mir Space Station as photographed from Space Shuttle Endeavour during STS-89 (January 1998). Mir's 15-year operational life included a fire, a depressurisation, and the longest continuous-occupation crew rotation in history before ISS. Most of what we know about crew dynamics under stress was learned on Mir.
